title: Laos Plantain Coconut Bake (Flourless Muffin)
hookLine: Global-inspired laos plantain coconut bake (flourless muffin) with 3 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mash the plantains until it has a paste consistency. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m53424_1}, {m53424_2}, and {m53424_3} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure coconut cream first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix togher the coconut cream and granulated sugar. Mix well. Add muffin liners to muffin pan. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Bake Laos Plantain Coconut Bake (Flourless Muffin) & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Fill the mixture into muffin pan. Bake for 45 minutes until baked all the way through. Let Laos Plantain Coconut Bake (Flourless Muffin) cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 6 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 38 mins!
